full_judgment:
3. FIR was lodged on 25.10.84 at about 9.45 in the morning. In the FIR lodged by informant Nawabul Alam, son of Golam Hossain who stated that the accused-appellants and others numbering about 50 suddenly encircled the deceased Belayet Khan and Golam Hossain. Lutfor, PW 2, was carried by them on their shoulders in order to commit murder. Lutfor Shaikh somehow managed to release himself from their clutches and came home running and narrated the incident to the inmates of the house but informant Nawabul Alam has not stated in the FIR the name of PW 3 Idris Shaikh, the alleged eye-witness in this occurrence and also about the commission of murder by the accused appellant and others. PW 1 although met Shawkat, PW 8, he also did not say anything as to the complicity of the accused in the commission of the crime. 

 11. PW 1 Nawabul Alam is an eye-witness and was told about the incident by Lutfor Shaikh PW 2 who was a companion of the victims who were returning from the Deodanga village after completion of the salish. It will be better to dwell on the testimony of PW 2 Lutfor Shaikh first because he happens to be the witness in whose presence the two other victims were kidnapped for the purpose of commission of murder. 

 12. PW 2 in his deposition has stated that on 24.10.84 he along with his uncle Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan went to Deodanga for attending a salish in the house of one Gopal Sarder (PW 9). He stated that after finishing the salish they were coming back and PWs 4 and 5 Mafiz and Shafi helped them to cross the river and took them up to the road While they reached near the house of Kamal Akhi at Venda village just before the sun set, he saw the accused appellants along with about 41 accused persons being armed with deadly weapons such as ramdao, valla, gupti and gun, encircle them. By the order of Tuku Mia, accused Shahjahan, Kuti, Saheb Ali and Dulu Biswas tied the hands and mouths of Belayet Khan. Mostain, Babu, Elias tied the hands and mouth of Golam Hossain and accused Mozibor Fakir caught his hand but he somehow ran away and reached the house of Golam Hossain and Nawab, narrated the story to Nawabul Alam, PW 1. Abul and some other. witnesses. All these witnesses searched for the victims but they did not find any of them. It is admitted by him that on 25.10.84 in the morning PW 3 Idris Shaikh told them about the killing of the deceased by the accused-appellants which PW 3 witnessed. Thereafter on 26.10.84 the dead bodies of Belayet Khan and Golam Hossain were recovered from Baronal Beel. 

 17. PWs 4 and 5 Mafiz Sader and Shafi Sarder helped Golam Hossain, Belayet and Lutfor to cross the river by boat They heard on the next morning at 8 AM at the police station from Nawab, No.1, that Golam Hossain and Belayet were murdered. 

 20. PW 8 in his evidence stated that he served in a godown of Kalia and on the day of occurrence he was returning to his own house at Pach Kaunia just before the sun set. On the way, near the culvert pool at Venda, he found accused Mustain, Tulu, Ilias, Shahjahan, Jutu Mia Shaikh, Saheb Shaikh, Harun and others being armed with valla, dao, lathi etc. and they were conspiring to do something. When he went a few step further, he found PW 2, Lutfor Shaikh, deceased Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan coming by that road. He found umbrellas in the hands of Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan. He returned home and thereafter taking his supper he went to the house of Kamal Akhi to enjoy the puja and met Kamal Akhi and thereafter on his way he heard from Rob, Eklas and Kuddus that Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan were missing. On Friday following, their dead bodies were recovered from a beel. It is stated by PW 8 Shawkat Mollah in his cross-examination that he met Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan and Lutfur Shaikh from 200/250 yards away and at that time the sun was still visible. He did not ask the accused why they were waiting there. When he was coming back he found Nawabul Alam along with police. But the evidence of PW 8 does not disclose any incriminating material or element to show that the accused killed the deceased or aided or abetted such murder. 

 28. This is the first recorded version of the prosecution case as to the missing of Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan on their way towards home from Jamrildanga. Thereafter on 25.10.84 at about 9-15 AM, PW 1 Nawabul Alam lodged the FIR with PS Kalia, Narail. On recording the said GD entry SI Sk. Baboruddin sent SI Wahidur Rahman with constable Anser Ali and also sent SI Abdul Ali, constable Shahjahan, Mokbul and Jamaluddin to investigate the matter and also to guard the area. It is stated by PW 1 that on hearing about the incident from Lutfor, PW 1 along with many others went to the police station and also searched for the missing victims. PW 3 has also stated that he informed PW 1 and others about the incident early in the morning at 8 AM. PW 2 Lutfor also stated in his deposition that Idris informed them about the complicity of the accused in the commission of murder. PW 4 Mafiz Sarder and PW 5 Shan Sarder also stated in their deposition that on 24.10.84 they went the police station and met PW 1 and others and heard about the murder of Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan. But this PW 9 also heard about the murder of the victims. But none of these witnesses heard the name of the murderers and nobody disclosed the names of the accused by name. Their statements appear to be wild and inconsistent with the first recorded version made in the GD entry as to the missing of Golam Hossain and Belayet Khan. But in the FIR which was lodged at a later stage, the names of accused persons are coming to light giving detailed particulars as to the encirclement by the accused party and attacking the victims and Lutfor Rahman. It is also stated in the FIR that the full particulars as to time, manner of attacking of Golam Hossain, Belayet Khan and Lutfor by the accused persons and PW 2 Lutfur Rahman who is the pivot of the narration of the whole prosecution story stated that 34 named accused persons in addition to 20/24 unknown accused persons encircled them near at the house of Kamal Akhi and lifted them on their shoulders in order to kill them. But Lutfor somehow managed to release himself from their clutches, came back home and narrated the entire incident to PW 1 and others. It is also stated in the FIR that getting news from PW 2 Lutfor, PW 1 and his uncle Abul Hossain and others started for the police station and met Habibur Rahman PW 7 and Bazlu Sk. (not examined) who stated to them about meeting with the accused persons who were armed with weapons and were discussing something near at the house of Kamal Akhi. The searching party searched for the missing persons but could not find them anywhere. They also met PW 8 Shawkat Ali, PW 6 Hannan Molla, who told the searching party that they saw Golam Hossain, Belayet Khan and Lutfor under the banyan tree at Venda road. But they did not state anything about the accused persons. 

 30. PWs 1 and 2 have suppressed the material facts and concocted new stories to suit their purpose. The PW s 1 and 2 during trial stated about the complicity of the accused party in details of each of the accused who caught hold of Golam Hossain, Belayet Khan and also Lutfor Rahman but there is no such mention in the FIR. Again, Lutfor Rahman, Nawabul Alam and others went to the police station at night on 24.10.84 but during the trial they denied that fact. It is a fact that the informant party after the GD Entry having been made, met the police officer at the thana and also at different times to discuss about the matter amongst themselves. It may be that FIR is the outcome of such discussions as the defence complains. During the trial prosecution further departed from the story of missing as stated in the GD entry. It is admitted by both the parties that enmity and hatred existed in between the parties. Eklasuddin, an Assembly member, uncle of accused No. 1 and father of accused Tunu was murdered by the informant party in broad day light. In that murder case PW 1 Nawabul Alam along with 9 others of the informant party were sentenced to death by the Court of Sessions. In another incident 3 close relations of the accused No. 1 were killed by PW 1 and others who were convicted and sentenced 10 life imprisonment in that criminal case and most of the witnesses are convicted accused in different criminal cases.
